title: Nepali Psalm 23 Multi-Tier Hanging Wall Plaque
description: A beautiful 5-panel hanging wall art piece featuring the complete biblical text of Psalm 23 (भजनसंग्रह २३) in elegant Nepali script. The panels are crafted with classic corner border accents and linked together by durable metal chains for easy wall mounting. It serves as a meaningful, faith-inspired decorative piece for home living spaces, prayer rooms, or as a thoughtful religious gift.

title: Inspirational Wooden Macrame Hanging
description: This cute, handmade ornament combines a natural wooden plate with a soft cotton macrame fringe. Each version comes in a different shape—like a circle, arch, or rectangle—and features a beautifully engraved message or scripture verse in English or Nepali. It includes a simple top loop, making it easy to hang as a lovely daily reminder in your car, bedroom, or any small space around the house.

title: You Are So Loved Macrame
description:
Bring warmth and heartfelt charm to any space with this handmade macrame wall hanging.

A natural wood semi-circle plaque is engraved with the sweet message “you are so loved” in elegant cursive script. Soft mustard-yellow cotton cords cascade below in a beautiful knotted pattern, finished with long flowing fringe that adds texture and movement.

Perfect for bedrooms, nurseries, living rooms, or as a thoughtful gift, this boho-inspired piece creates a cozy, loving atmosphere wherever it’s hung. Easy to display with the included white hanging cord.
